decisions_recorded: Keep GitHub/GitHub Actions temporary only; no Jenkins, Forgejo, or ArgoCD interim authority.
Bootstrap Rust deterministically before Buck2 fanout to avoid rustup lazy-install races on GitHub runners.
Pin Rust via rust-toolchain.toml with rustfmt, clippy, llvm-tools-preview, and Linux targets needed by Buck2 probes.
Keep Buck2 as build/test/check authority and LLVM source-based coverage as Rust coverage authority; Tarpaulin remains out of CI authority.
Do not claim P0.0 green, Phase 0 complete, protected branch authority, live Kubernetes mutation, or native oya-ci readiness.

live_ci_diagnostic.fix: serialize rustup toolchain/component/target/bootstrap before any Buck2 lane action; install llvm-tools-preview and Linux targets; then install Buck2 if missing
live_ci_diagnostic.representative_failure: rustup component download/rename conflicts under /home/runner/.rustup while Buck2 actions executed in parallel
live_ci_diagnostic.root_cause: fresh GitHub runner let multiple Buck2 actions trigger rustup lazy toolchain/component installs concurrently; coverage lane also required explicit llvm-tools-preview for llvm-profdata/llvm-cov from the pinned rustup sysroot
